remarks: The perfect blend of classic charm and modern elegance in this completely remodeled and reimagined 1950 farmhouse colonial, nestled on a lush acre in the sought-after Revonah Woods area. This stunning home boasts five well-appointed bedrooms, including a versatile main-level bedroom that can serve as a home office or guest room with a full bath. An open flow concept seamlessly connects the living spaces, creating an inviting atmosphere that's ideal for entertaining and comfortable living. The thoughtful design honors the home's original character while incorporating contemporary finishes and amenities that cater to today's lifestyle. The dramatic kitchen with vaulted ceiling, 2 sinks & 2 dishwashers & dining area. Large windows bathe the interior in natural light. Upstairs are 4 generous sized bedrooms. The primary suite is a luxurious retreat, featuring walk in closet and spa-like ensuite bathroom. Outside, the property's acreage offers a private in ground heated pool with plenty of room for outdoor activities and relaxation. Enjoy summer breezes in the screened porch off of the living room. There is also a finished lower level. The home's idyllic setting in Revonah Woods offers a serene environment while still being conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, and houses of worship.
